slot_note: Re-root of task139 (architecture 1 spent on the portal, both responses on the golden). The world, the decision and the quantity are kept (seventeen nurse teams of twenty places across eight claim units, at most three a unit, the ultimate indemnity they save booked in the AY2027 pick, a randomised pilot with an independent verification); the organisation is redrawn from a stock carrier to a group self-insurance trust because financial_institution is banned against task304, and the decisive step is new: the pilot called and assessed every drawn intake before splitting its pairs, so the randomised contrast is the file's increment over a called intake, while a unit with no team has no calls.
niche: a Missouri employers' group self-insurance trust placing seventeen early-return nurse teams across eight claim units for accident year 2027 and booking the ultimate indemnity they save in its AY2027 pick, when the pilot's nurses called and assessed every drawn intake, worker and employer, before splitting its pairs
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads the register, the review, the charter and the pick memo right reads the randomised pilot per assigned intake, each arm's indemnity-claim rate times its verified severity, values each unit's teams at that saving over an ERN intake's place-days and files HC-SS 2, MF-SS 3, RW-SS and CN-SS none and three to each other-injury unit with a credit of about 2.7 million, because every drawn intake had the opening call before its pair was split, so the usual-handling arm is a called intake and the contrast is only what a file adds; a unit with no team has no calls, and read against the intakes the pilot never drew the call keeps about a fifth of the strain intakes inside the waiting period and reaches every intake of a unit once one team works there.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is a workers' compensation pure premium per intake, the indemnity-claim rate times the verified ultimate severity, under no call, the call and the call with a file, the call working through the employer's suitable duties inside Missouri's three-day waiting period; with another field's nouns there is no waiting period that turns a short absence into a claim paying nothing, no conversion of a report into an indemnity claim and no accident-year ultimate, and the task stops reading the same.

spine.entity: one claim reported to the trust with time off work at first report, or one that later paid indemnity
spine.source: constructed (the trust's claims system listing of time-off and indemnity claims)

world.org_type: group self-insurance trust of Missouri employers, owned by its members and administering its own claims

driver: A pilot that randomised a service only among units that had all first received the programme's opening contact measures only what the service adds to a contacted unit, while a group the programme does not reach gets no contact at all; the programme's saving is the contacted units' own gain over the units the pilot never drew, which every unit of a group receives once one team works there, plus the service's increment on the units the capacity takes, so valuing every team at the randomised increment per unit of capacity sends the capacity away from the groups where the contact does most of the work.
driver_concrete: Every intake the pilot drew had an Early Return nurse's opening call on its triage day, worker and employer, before its pair was split, and the call's question about suitable duties keeps about a fifth of the strain intakes inside the three-day waiting period; the randomised contrast is the file's increment over a called intake, while the 2027 counterfactual (a unit with no team) has no calls, so the call's saving is read per intake from the two in three intakes the pilot never drew against the called usual-handling arm, credited to every intake of a unit with a team, and the files' increment credited per place-day.
stump: A competent solver reads the pilot per assigned intake, values each unit's teams at usual handling's indemnity per intake less ERN's over the place-days an ERN intake held, and files two teams in healthcare strains, three in manufacturing strains, none in retail or construction strains and three in each other-injury unit with a credit of about 2,700,000 dollars; the step that lands it there is taking the usual-handling arm as a unit with no team, when every drawn intake had the opening call before its pair was split and a unit with no team has no calls: read against the intakes the screen never drew, the call keeps about a fifth of the strain intakes from ever paying indemnity and reaches every intake of a unit once one team works there, so each strain unit takes a team for its calls, manufacturing strains a second for its files, the other-injury units three each, and the credit is about 5,600,000 dollars.

lineage.niche: a regional workers' compensation carrier placing seventeen early-intervention nurse teams across eight claim segments for accident year 2027 and booking the ultimate indemnity they save in the AY2027 indemnity pick, when the pilot's nurses kept part of their intakes from ever paying indemnity
lineage.driver: An intervention assigned at random at intake changes how many of its units go on to become the recorded costly cases as well as what those cases cost, so its effect has to be read per assigned unit, each arm's own conversion times its own cost, and valued per unit of the capacity each assigned unit holds; read per recorded case, it compares a costlier remainder of one arm with the ordinary cases of the other and places the capacity where the recorded cases are dearest.
lineage.driver_concrete: The pilot assigned intakes with time off at first report at random, half to Early Return nurses, and the nurses kept about a fifth to a quarter of the healthcare, retail and manufacturing strain intakes from ever paying indemnity (back on suitable duties inside the waiting period), while the independent review verified a sample of indemnity claims only; the saving a team buys is indemnity per assigned intake (each arm's own indemnity-claim rate times its own verified severity) over the nurse place-days an assigned intake holds, which puts the teams in the strain segments, where the saving per verified indemnity claim reads as four to six per cent and leaves healthcare and retail strains without a team.
lineage.stump: A competent solver compares the verified ultimates of the two arms' indemnity claims in each segment, values each segment's teams per place-day of an indemnity claim at that saving and files teams in the other-injury and construction units, none in healthcare or retail strains, with a run-rate credit of 2,000,000 dollars; the step that lands it there is reading the saving per indemnity claim when the nurses kept part of their intakes from ever paying indemnity, so the programme arm's indemnity claims are the costlier remainder: per assigned intake the teams go to the strain segments, retail strains takes the two teams its intakes keep in use, and the credit is 4,100,000 dollars.
lineage.answer: three teams each to HC-SS, MF-SS, MF-OT, CN-OT and HC-OT, two to RW-SS, none to RW-OT or CN-SS; an AY2027 indemnity credit of 4,100,000 dollars
lineage.stakeholder_role: director of medical case management, who places the nurse teams and supplies the saving to the AY2027 pick
lineage.fate: spent 2026-10-26 on the portal: both responses landed the call (three teams each in HC-SS, MF-SS, MF-OT, CN-OT and HC-OT, two in RW-SS, none in RW-OT or CN-SS, 4.1 million); reading a randomised pilot per assigned intake is the domain's own reflex, and the whole ladder sat inside the register's two arms

notes: stump_strategy causal_design: the decisive step is the comparison the 2027 counterfactual needs (a unit with no team has no calls), which the pilot's own control arm is not; gate_g decomposition_attribution: the programme's saving is split between the call, reaching every intake of a unit with a team, and the file, reaching the intakes the places take, and the split decides the placement. G5 names the mechanism: part of the saving the decision buys is provided by a component both arms received. Lower rungs: G1 (the first team valued per intake reached, later teams per place-day), G9 (architecture 1's per-claim reading).
